subject: POC ignition — owners, success metrics & calendar alignment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finovate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC ignition — owners, success metrics & calendar alignment

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to evaluate Redwood for the payments reconciliation use case. We'd like to lock in a short POC kickoff (45–60 minutes) to align on success criteria, owners, timeline, and any procurement/security checkpoints.

Proposed agenda:
- Introductions and roles (AE, SE, customer owners) — 10m
- Success criteria and sample dataset review — 15m
- Timeline & milestones (deliverables, data access) — 10m
- Action items and owners (procurement/security contacts) — 10m

High-level availability from our side (PT):
- Wed 9/8 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu 9/9 09:00–11:30 or 16:00–18:00

If you can share a couple windows that work for Priya and your engineering lead, Dev and Marissa will attend from our side (SE + CSM). I attached a one-pager for suggested success criteria and a brief pre-kickoff checklist.

Also please let us know whether Finovate requires a separate security-only session with your security team the week after kickoff — we can route Soojin (our security lead) if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf, pre-kickoff-checklist.xlsx
From: Alex Johnson <alex@finovate.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovate.com>, security@finovate.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC ignition — owners, success metrics & calendar alignment

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Priya (procurement) and our lead SWE, Markus, are out for the rest of the week except for short windows. Quick notes:
- Priya prefers afternoons PT (15:00–16:30) on Thu 9/9 or Fri 9/10.
- Markus can do Thu 9/9 16:30–17:30 PT but has meetings earlier.
- Security would like a separate 30-minute session later that week; they asked for an inventory of data access requirements ahead of time.

Can you do Thu 9/9 16:30 PT? If so, include a calendar invite and call-in details. Also, please confirm whether you need any IP whitelisting/hostnames for our infra team before the session.

Alex
Director, Engineering | Finovate Systems
alex@finovate.com
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finovate.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 01:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ignition — owners, success metrics & calendar alignment

Hi Alex —

Thu 9/9 16:30 PT works for us. I'll lead the technical portion and bring a quick demo of the minimal dataset flow so we can validate success criteria live. Action items I need before the kickoff:
- A 2–3 row CSV (anonymized) with the two reconciliation cases you mentioned — so we can pre-load and avoid delays.
- Any network constraints (IPs/whitelists) if you want to test direct connectivity during the POC.

Soojin, can you confirm whether a separate security-only call on Fri 9/10 10:00 PT works? If security requests a documentation dump, refer them to the Drive link I shared (POC evidence folder).

I'll create the calendar invite and include the agenda, success criteria document, and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Subject: Re: POC ignition — owners, success metrics & calendar alignment (Updated invites)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the update and for being flexible. Confirming the revised plan: 
- Fri 2026-09-10 10:00 PT — Security-only (30m) — attendees: Soojin Lee (Redwood), Finovate security (security@finovate.com)
- Fri 2026-09-10 11:00 PT — POC kickoff (60m) — attendees: Alex Johnson, Markus (Finovate SWE), Priya Shah (Procurement), Vivek, Dev, Marissa (Redwood)

I attached the POC success criteria doc (v1) and a short pre-kickoff checklist. Dev will run the demo and I will capture owners and next steps. Key success metrics we'll validate during the POC:
- End-to-end reconciliation accuracy >= 98% on the sample cases
- End-to-end latency for batch reconciliation under 90s for 10k records
- Ability to run a nightly job via your environment (proof of concept run)

Pre-kickoff actions (owners):
- Finovate: share anonymized 2–3 row CSV by Thu EOD — Alex / Markus
- Finovate infra: confirm whether any IP whitelisting is required — Priya / infra@finovate.com
- Redwood: provide brief architecture diagram + evidence bundle for security — Soojin
- Redwood: calendar invites + meeting notes template — Vivek

I've created updated calendar invites (attached calendar-invite.ics) and a GDrive link to the documents in case your security team needs to pull them ahead of the call: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOCsuccess

If anything else changes, ping me here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to Friday.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
